text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph on pure white seamless background, soft neutral studio light, entire items visible, realistic materials. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin, hanger, stand, typography, logos or watermark. A single narrow black leather hip belt with silver-tone eyelets and simple metal ring/buckle, combined with a short draped oval-link silver chain extending across its front, presented as one wearable belt assembly. No fur charm.
original_prompt: Reference defines clothing/accessory design only. Create one photorealistic product image, pure white seamless background, portrait 2:3, soft neutral studio lighting, realistic materials, whole item visible with margins. No person, skin, face, hair, braids, visible mannequin, stand, hanger, typography or watermark. Preserve visible reference design; do not invent decoration. Extract ONLY the following accessory, no other garments or accessories. A single narrow black leather hip belt with silver-tone eyelets and simple metal ring/buckle, combined with a short draped oval-link silver chain extending across its front, presented as one wearable belt assembly. No fur charm.
reproduction_note: 依据用户提供造型图整理为纯白背景无人服装、独立配饰与完整造型。小尺寸耳饰和鼻钉细节、头发遮挡部分保守补全；不作精确款号或品牌鉴定。需保持设计时结合原参考，不承诺纯文字逐像素复现。
